figurative_meaning_en: to set a trap or snare
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশ অপরাধীকে ধরার জন্য জাল পেতেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The police are setting a trap to catch the criminal.
The businessmen are laying a snare to trap their rival.
note: Idiom draws from traditional fishing or hunting practices in Bengali rural life, metaphorically applied to modern contexts like policing.
